nodes.long_description:
Predator Panic is a VR heist with no buttons for walking. You move like a monkey: push off the ground, swing your arms and climb trees with your own hands.

STEAL THE EGGS
Sneak into nests guarded by real-size dinosaurs, by day or by night, and grab all the eggs you dare. Get caught and they spill.

NEW: YOUR OWN CAMERA
Film videos and take photos in VR. It can follow you, see through your eyes or float still for the perfect shot.

SIX HUNTERS
- The Hatchery: sleeping raptors. One loud slap wakes them.
- The Dried River: a Metriacanthosaurus rams the tree you hide in.
- The Volcano: a T-Rex that only sees what moves.
- The Paddock: the Spectrex turns invisible. Use thermal goggles.
- The Ocean: dive to a shipwreck for Tylosaurus eggs.
- The Frozen Peak: a Yutyrannus tracks you in the snow.

BIG FREE PLAY
A giant map for your whole room, every hunter at once and chaos every 2 minutes. Drive jeeps, survive!

BELOW ZERO
Find 6 clues to open the Mine Lift, then hide from what lives down there.

GEAR UP
Sell eggs for coins. Buy grenades, tranq darts, flares, a mini-sub and 35 cosmetics.

MINI GAMES
- Zombie Waves: endless zombies, dual wield, leaderboards.
- Dino Hunt: one player is the dinosaur, the rest escape.
- Fossil Dig: dig up fossils. Beware the Spinosaurus!

PLAY TOGETHER
Room codes or public rooms, up to 10 players, with proximity voice chat. Share fan art in our Discord!

Online play needs an internet connection. Mute, block and report tools are built in.
nodes.short_description: You're a monkey. They're dinosaurs. Swing, climb and sprint with your own arms through jungle, volcano, ruined paddock, open ocean and a frozen mountain to steal dinosaur eggs, then get out before you're caught. Play alone, or team up with friends online with proximity voice chat. Uncover the secret world Below Zero. Sell your eggs, deck out your monkey and gear up for the next heist. Or fight off zombie waves, hunt your friends as a dinosaur, or dig up fossils in the desert.

nodes.long_description:
Predator Panic is a VR heist with no buttons for walking. You move like a monkey: push off the ground, swing your arms and climb trees with your own hands.

STEAL THE EGGS
Sneak into nests guarded by real-size dinosaurs and grab as many eggs as you dare. Every egg makes your bag heavier and slower. Get caught and your eggs spill on the ground.

FOUR HUNTERS, FOUR WAYS TO SURVIVE
- The Hatchery: raptors sleep on their nests. One loud slap and they wake up.
- The Dried River: a Metriacanthosaurus that hunts alone and rams the tree you're hiding in.
- The Volcano: a T-Rex that only sees what moves. Freeze, or hide in the caves.
- The Paddock: the Spectrex camouflages itself. Listen for it, or spot it with thermal goggles.
The longer you stay, the darker it gets and the sharper they hunt.

GEAR UP
Sell eggs at the station's incubator for coins. Spend them on stun grenades, tranquilizer darts, flares, smoke bombs, bigger backpacks and thermal goggles, plus around 20 cosmetics, from leaf crowns to a T-Rex head helmet.

PLAY TOGETHER
Join a room with a code or go public. Ride the party elevators down in a team of up to 6. The dinosaurs get tougher with every extra player, and every egg is shared with the whole team. Proximity voice chat lets you whisper plans, or scream.

Or just climb the giant trees of the free-play jungle and try to stay away from the raptors.

Online play needs an internet connection. Mute, block and report tools are built in.
nodes.short_description: You're a monkey. They're dinosaurs. Swing, climb and sprint with your own arms through jungle, volcano and ruined paddock to steal dinosaur eggs from right under their noses, then get out before you're caught. Play alone, or team up with friends online and hear each other with proximity voice chat. Sell your eggs, deck out your monkey and gear up for the next heist.

nodes.change_log:
Update 0.17.1: THE CAMERA IS NOW A BIG TABLET!

NEW: THE CAMERA TABLET

Your camera is now a big tablet, and you keep it on your back. Reach over your left shoulder and grip to take it.
Touch the buttons round its screen with your other hand: the modes along the bottom, zoom on the left, and video, photo, record and MENU on the right.
Pull the trigger, or touch REC, to record a video or take a photo.
In FOLLOW, EYES and FLOAT the whole tablet flies.
With your egg bag on, the tablet rides on the back of the bag. Reach past the top of the bag for it.
FIXES

Fixed Free Play's dinosaurs freezing for your friends when lots of them were out.

Update 0.17.0: THE CAMERA!

NEW: YOUR OWN CAMERA

Everyone now has a camera clipped to the front of their belt. Reach down and grip to take it.
Pull the trigger to record a video or take a photo. Videos have the game's sound, your friends' voices and your own.
Press MENU on its back to pick how it films:
HANDHELD: films whatever you point it at.
SELFIE: turns round and films you.
FOLLOW: let go and it flies behind you (or a friend) and follows.
EYES: films exactly what you (or a friend) see.
FLOAT: let go and it stays in the air right there, for the perfect shot.
Three shapes: 16:9, 9:16 (for shorts) and square.
Looks: night vision, black and white, and old VHS tape.
Zoom, smoothness, a 3-2-1 photo timer, and CLEAN SHOT to hide menus and name tags.
While the camera's away from you, a remote on your left wrist shows what it sees, starts and stops recording, and calls it back.
MY VOICE: keep your own voice out of your videos. Turning your mic off in the wrist menu keeps it out too.
Everyone sees your camera, with a red light while it records.
Videos are saved on your headset in Movies, and photos in Pictures (both in a "Predator Panic" folder).
FREE PLAY FIXES

A friend who leaves Free Play and comes straight back in can see you again.
Events now happen at the same time for everyone in the room.
A friend driving a jeep no longer looks like they're floating with no jeep.

Update 0.16.0: DAY AND NIGHT!

NEW: DAY AND NIGHT

Every level now has day and night. You start in the day, and after a few minutes the sun sets... with no warning.
At night, tap the side of your head to switch your head lamp on or off. It comes on by itself at sunset.
In the dark the dinosaurs only spot you up close, unless your lamp gives you away.
Their eyes glow in the dark.
Night brings creepy music and night sounds: far-off roars, growls nearby and footsteps that shake the ground.
SCARIER CATCHES

Every hunter now catches you its own way. Raptors claw at you, the Metriacanthosaurus rams you, the T-Rex comes down from above, the Spectrex appears out of nowhere, the Yutyrannus bursts out of the snow and the Tylosaurus drags you under.
Below Zero: the Troodon pack leaps at you from all sides, and B2's hunter slashes with its giant claws. Creepy music and sounds down there too.
The Ocean Cruiser's chomp is scarier: the lights flicker and die and the glass cracks.
FREE PLAY

NIGHT FALLS!: a new event that turns day into night for 2 minutes. Head lamps and jeep lights come on, and eyes glow in the dark. It replaces the blackout.
The volcano eruption is huge now: giant glowing rocks that leave burning craters, knock you flying, knock dinosaurs down and blow up jeeps!
FIXES

Level 1, LIGHT FINGERS: the patrol raptor no longer knows every time you take an egg. It has to see you, or be right next to the nest.
Bigger backpacks now stay in your hand right where you grab them.
B2: a rock wall no longer hides the lift, and the hunter can't get stuck behind a wall.
The Spinosaurus's eyes now glow on its eyes, not above them.

Update 0.15.0: BIG FREE PLAY!

NEW: BIG FREE PLAY
- Go through the big blast door in the Expeditions hall to reach a giant new map. It replaces the old small jungle.
- Everyone in your room who comes through lands on the same map, up to 10 players!
- Every hunter is out at once: raptors, the Metriacanthosaurus, the T-Rex, the Spectrex, the Yutyrannus and a Spinosaurus. They roam everywhere, so split up and see who you run into.
- In the desert, the Spinosaurus swims under the sand with only its sail showing... until it bursts out.
- Every 2 minutes something big happens: a raptor stampede, a blackout where only their eyes glow, a volcano eruption, a giant boss or a lightning storm.
- Drive old park jeeps with your friends. Big dinosaurs can flip them!
- A map on your wrist shows you, your friends and the way back to camp.
- Your gear refills here, so use it as much as you like.
- The camp is the only safe place. Get caught and you wake up back there.

SINGLE PLAYER
- Every elevator has a new SINGLE PLAYER key. Step in alone, pick a level and press it to play on your own, even while you're in a room.

Update 0.15.0: BIG FREE PLAY and BELOW ZERO part 2!

NEW: BIG FREE PLAY

Go through the big blast door in the Expeditions hall to reach a giant new map. It replaces the old small jungle.
Everyone in your room who comes through lands on the same map, up to 10 players!
Every hunter is out at once: raptors, the Metriacanthosaurus, the T-Rex, the Spectrex, the Yutyrannus and a Spinosaurus. They roam everywhere, so split up and see who you run into.
In the desert, the Spinosaurus swims under the sand with only its sail showing... until it bursts out.
Every 2 minutes something big happens: a raptor stampede, a blackout where only their eyes glow, a volcano eruption, a giant boss or a lightning storm.
Drive old park jeeps with your friends. Big dinosaurs can flip them!
A map on your wrist shows you, your friends and the way back to camp.
Your gear refills here, so use it as much as you like.
The camp is the only safe place. Get caught and you wake up back there.
SINGLE PLAYER

Every elevator has a new SINGLE PLAYER key. Step in alone, pick a level and press it to play on your own, even while you're in a room.
NEW LEVEL: B2, THE MUSHROOM FOREST

Finish B1's 3 quests to unlock B2 on the Mine Lift.
A giant glowing cave of mushrooms, home to a huge Therizinosaurus with giant claws.
Mushrooms you touch glow, and it follows the glow.
It can cut down the mushroom you're climbing, with you on it!
Bounce on bouncy caps, climb shelf mushrooms and swing on hanging roots.
Don't bump into the babies...
More of the story at Dr. Marsh's camp, and 3 new quests: BOING BOING, HIGH ROAD and NO GLOW.
FOSSIL DIG GOT HARDER

The Spinosaurus is faster and comes every 5 minutes, and even more often at night.
It gets hungrier with every visit where nobody gets caught.
In a strong sandstorm you can't see its sail. Listen for the rattle!
It can ram your buggy or truck and flip it over.
The engine upgrade now has 6 levels, so you can go faster than ever.
The desert is truly endless now. Drive as far as you like.
Fixed: sometimes you couldn't get out of a car. A/X always gets you out now.
ALSO NEW

The Ocean Cruiser now costs 40,000 coins (was 80,000).
When a friend gets caught, it looks better now.
Fixed: friends sometimes stayed invisible for a long time after joining a room.
